subject: Bridge to launch: final decision checklist, signature timing and proposed start slot
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria@stellarqube.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarqube.com, Tom Reed <tom.reed@legalvoice.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Final SOW redlines + target signature window

Hi Ava / Laura —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our legal and procurement teams finished a pass on the SOW and MAP and attached the redlines (SOW_StellarQube_v3_redlines.pdf). Procurement is pressing to lock a start week for their onboarding calendar.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the latest mutual action plan (MAP) with the final approvers and an estimated signature day?
- If we sign by next Thursday (Sep 2), can Redwood commit to a Sep 15 start slot for onboarding, or do you need more runway?

Tom from our legal team is on copy for any redline discussions. We’d like to have a single go/no-go decision scheduled so our PMs can block calendar.

Best,
Maria Santos
Head of Cloud Integrations | StellarQube

Attachments: SOW_StellarQube_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Santos <maria@stellarqube.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final SOW redlines + target signature window

Hi Maria —

Thanks for sending the redlines. I’ve converted the procurement notes into a short MAP spreadsheet (see attached StellarQube_MAP_v4.xlsx) that calls out: approver names, e-sign route, final SLA appendix, and the on-call ramp week. Key points:

- Internal approvers: Legal (Laura), Finance (Marcus), Sales Ops (Priyom).
- Target signature day to hit Sep 15 start: EOD Thu, 2 Sep 2027 (allows 2 weeks for DocuSign routing + internal pre-onsite prep).
- If legal needs additional redline time, plan B is Sep 22 start.
- We can accept a partial start (restricted early access to hosted API + sandbox) if procurement needs a phased ramp.

I’ve attached an SOW with inline replies to the redlines and a proposed acceptance clause. I’ll coordinate an internal go/no-go checklist run tomorrow morning with Laura and Marcus and will share a final DocuSign link once internal approvals are confirmed.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura: confirm legal language on the data retention appendix by Tue 31 Aug noon PT.
2) Marcus: confirm Finance OK on the credit/commitment cadence by Tue 31 Aug EOD PT.
3) Priyom: prepare an ops ramp note (capacity + staging) so we can commit to the Sep 15 start if signed on Sep 2.

I’ll also propose a 30-minute decision slot with Maria and procurement on Thu Sep 2 at 10am PT to collect signatures.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: StellarQube_MAP_v4.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB); SOW_StellarQube_v3_redlines_replied.pdf (PDF, 310KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge to launch: final decision checklist, signature timing and proposed start slot

Ava —

Quick legal read: the data retention appendix needs one minor tweak (clarify logs retention for dedicated deployments vs hosted). I’ll add exact text by 12:00 PT as requested. Also flag: procurement asked about SOC 2 evidence timeline; we can ship our SOC 2 audit extract within 48 hours of signature.

I don’t expect the redlines to materially change commercial terms — mostly clarifying language. If Marcus signs off on the financial cadence, I’m comfortable greenlighting legal to approve and route for signature.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge to launch: final decision checklist, signature timing and proposed start slot

Team —

I ran a quick capacity check against the proposed Sep 15 start. Short answer: feasible if we receive DocuSign-executed SOW by Sep 6 EOD PT. That gives Platform team ~6 business days to reserve the Dedicated pool and validate the model build pipeline. If signature slips to Sep 9–10, we should plan a Sep 22 onboarding.

I attached a one-page ramp plan that lists the minimum checkpoints (network prep, KMS key exchange, preprovisioned GPU pool). Priyom — please confirm the overnight staging test window and whether we need a short blackout for other large launches that week.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance & Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_ramp_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

From: Maria Santos <maria@stellarqube.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarqube.com, Tom Reed <tom.reed@legalvoice.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge to launch: final decision checklist, signature timing and proposed start slot

Ava / Team —

We reviewed the MAP and the updated SOW. Procurement has approved the commercial terms provided Finance confirms the credit hold (Marcus — thanks for the ramp plan). Legal (Tom) has no remaining blocking edits. We agreed internally to sign on Thu, Sep 2.

I’m confirming the DocuSign session for Thu Sep 2 at 10:00 AM PT and have requested that Procurement circulate the single e-sign packet (SOW + MAP + SLA appendix). Please make sure Laura’s final data retention clause is in that packet.

Assuming signatures clear on Sep 2, we accept the Sep 15 onboarding week and will schedule our PMs accordingly. If anything changes I’ll let you know immediately.

Maria Santos
Head of Cloud Integrations | StellarQube

Attachments referenced: DocuSign packet (will be sent by procurement); Procurement approval note (email thread).
